reading: How the assertions of one field become one status. Ordered rules, first match wins, exceptions on top. The pack never decides which source prevails: when current sources disagree, every value is shown side by side with its source, date and edition.

event_supersedes_earlier_state.note: A later event document (deed, resolution, transfer, appointment, office transfer) makes every earlier value of the field historical. What an event document proves against a registry extract is a legal question: the pack only orders documents by date.

later_edition_supersedes_same_series.note: Within one series of state documents (registry extracts, holders' ledger, the financial summary of one year) only the latest edition is a current witness; earlier editions are history.

same_day_state_is_current.note: A state document dated on the same day as the latest event is treated as current: if it differs, the difference is shown rather than assumed away.

adjudication.note: No source is preferred. A human adjudicates.

rules.reason: no current source for this field
rules.rationale: Nothing to show: the field is written [TO CONFIRM], never filled.
Exception above every single-value rule: current sources disagree. Every value is kept with its sources; none is chosen.

rules.reason: the current sources of this field could not be read
rules.rationale: The latest event document (or every current witness) is unreadable for this field. An older value is history and is never promoted back to current.
Every readable current source gives the same value. It is shown once, with the latest source first and the others listed.

outgoing_scan.reading: Scanner for outgoing documents that still carry a superseded value. Ordered guards, first match wins, exceptions on top; the default flags the line.

rules.rationale: A document written before the change carried the value that was current on its own date.

rules.rationale: The same amount without the cue of the field (an invoice, a guarantee) is another figure.

rules.rationale: The line itself presents the amount as a past value.

rules.rationale: The nearest entity named is not the entity whose value was superseded.

rules.rationale: No mention of the entity in the line or in the lines just above.
